title: Predicting Inference-Time Scaling Gains from Labeled Validation-Set Output Statistics
abstract: arXiv:2606.02981v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Verifier-selected best-of-N scaling (drawing N candidate answers from a language model and returning the one a reward model ranks highest) improves accuracy by an amount that varies across models, but measuring that gain directly requires both candidate generation and reward-model scoring. Prior work links cheap statistics of a model's sampled outputs and validation-set correctness (how often samples agree, how diverse they are, how confident the model is, and where correct samples appear) to model behavior, but does not isolate which of these form a compact predictor of best-of-N gain. We fit ridge predictors on features from one round of sampling on a labeled validation set, use bootstrap-Lasso to measure how often candidate features are selected across resamples, and give an error bound that accounts for the limits of a linear predictor. translated_title: 从带标注验证集的输出统计量预测推理时扩展增益
translated_abstract: 验证器选择的最佳N选一扩展（从语言模型中抽取N个候选答案，并返回奖励模型排名最高的那个）能够提升准确率，但提升幅度因模型而异，直接测量该增益需要同时进行候选生成和奖励模型评分。先前的工作将模型采样输出的廉价统计量（样本之间的一致程度、多样性、模型置信度以及正确样本出现的位置）与验证集正确率及模型行为联系起来，但并未分离出其中哪些统计量能够构成最佳N选一增益的紧凑预测器。我们在带标注验证集上进行一轮采样，基于所得特征拟合岭回归预测器，并使用bootstrap-Lasso衡量候选特征在重采样中被选中的频率，同时给出了考虑线性预测器局限性的误差界。仅使用四个特征，我们的预测器与实测增益之间的Spearman秩相关系数达到0.90。
tldr: 该论文提出仅利用带标注验证集上一轮采样得到的四个输出统计特征，即可高精度（Spearman秩相关0.90）预测语言模型最佳N选一推理扩展带来的准确率增益，从而免去昂贵的候选生成与奖励模型评分过程。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that just four output statistics from a single round of sampling on a labeled validation set can predict best-of-N inference-time scaling gains with a Spearman rank correlation of 0.90, avoiding costly candidate generation and reward-model scoring.
